source_snapshot.procedure: Open BMC Web Inventory and LEDs, turn the LED light control on and off, and check behavior.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Its generic Lit write is only half the source cycle, lacks safe credentials/resource binding and requests evidence from an unrelated temperature sensor.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly changes YES because physical identity and visible on/off behavior need an operator even though the control and readback are automatable.
historical_reviews.history: Same code row 1067 is an in-band SEL Allocation read and cannot provide history or evidence for this LED case; row 1692 must remain separate.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Logical IndicatorLED state and emitted light are two independent oracles. Each transition needs controller readback plus a human-observed exact chassis/LED/color or blink result, followed by restoration to the captured initial state.

original_test_intent: Validate that the BMC Inventory and LEDs control drives the intended physical Identify/UID LED on the exact chassis through the documented on and off behaviors and returns it to its original state.
original_method: Bind the Web label to the exact protected Redfish/IPMI LED resource and physical chassis location, record controller and visible baseline including color/blink, obtain operator approval, set the documented on state and correlate readback with physical observation, set off and correlate again, then restore the original state and verify no power, fault or service indicator changed.
manual_activity: An operator at the identified chassis confirms the exact LED, color/blink and on/off transitions; the owner approves the bounded writes and owns restoration and verdict.
required_inputs: Physical LED location and Identify/UID role
Operator visual access and evidence method
Baseline restoration and wrong-indicator recovery procedure
safety_requirements: Never infer the LED role from a generic Chassis/system path
Do not touch power, fault, thermal or service controls
Use protected credentials and validated endpoint identity
Obtain confirmation before the first write
Read back each transition and pair it with physical observation
Stop on wrong LED, color/blink mismatch, stale readback or unrelated state change
Restore the captured baseline rather than assuming Off
Preserve logs and do not automatically retry
agent_execution_scope: Collect exact resource and baseline controller state
Validate Web/API mapping and allowed values
Issue one approved on transition and readback
Issue approved off/restoration transition and readback
Verify no unrelated control changed and report evidence without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve exact LED mapping and bounded transitions
Physically observe and identify the chassis LED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The proposed IndicatorLED Lit write/readback is related but incomplete: it uses unsafe `-k` and inline credentials, assumes a generic resource, omits the Off write/restoration and substitutes TEMP_M2 evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use the discovered protected LED resource for one approved on/readback/physical observation and one off/readback/physical observation, then restore the actual baseline.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The on/off cycle, physical behavior and 10/10-minute estimates remain; no temperature-sensor evidence is accepted.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Record a transition ledger with requested state, API response, readback timestamp, physical state/color/blink, observer and restoration result for baseline-to-on-to-off-to-baseline as applicable.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Defines correct behavior and proves the logical resource maps to the intended physical indicator.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: API readback alone cannot prove emitted light or physical location; a photo alone cannot prove which BMC resource caused it.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Some schemas deprecate IndicatorLED or map it to another property, and shared chassis resources can point to a different enclosure, so discovery and identity binding are mandatory.

project_override_considerations: The Project must identify whether this control is UID/Identify and specify its physical color/blink semantics. The row-1067 SEL allocation and row-1692 same-code variants must never be merged with this result.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/Variant ID, SUT/BMC/chassis identity and LED resource/location mapping
Baseline controller and physical state with color/blink semantics
Protected on request/readback and timestamped physical-on observation
Protected off request/readback and timestamped physical-off observation
Original-state restoration and no power/fault/service-control change
BMC/audit/SEL review, recovery actions and engineer-owned verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master Items, procedure and criteria consistently define LED on/off behavior. The unrelated TEMP_M2 text is a DeepSeek-layer defect and the duplicate code has distinct source identities; neither changes the Master target.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The LED mapping, physical semantics and operator access are normal project inputs. Execution is gated until obtained, but the intended operation and recovery are identifiable.

review_improvement: Completes both transitions, rejects copied sensor evidence, isolates the duplicate identity and correlates protected controller state with the exact physical LED before restoring baseline.
independent_technical_reasoning: An LED control test crosses a digital-to-physical boundary. The BMC can report Lit while the wrong enclosure or failed emitter remains dark, and a visible LED can be driven by another controller. Correlated per-transition timestamps and exact chassis identity establish causality; restoring the captured initial state avoids changing an operator's pre-existing identify signal.
